# Hand-maintained spelling vocabulary. The generated half is in
# .github/cspell-registry.txt, which is built from shared/registry - a new title
# or provider needs nothing here.
#
# What belongs here is everything that cannot be derived: the field names other
# people's APIs chose, the proper nouns of the games themselves, the handles the
# fixtures use, and the handful of words this repository spells deliberately.
#
# Adding a word is a small decision with a long tail. The question to ask is
# "would a reader be right to think this is a typo?" - if yes, it belongs in the
# code differently, not here.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Field names and method names other people's APIs chose.
#
# Steam, Hi-Rez, PandaScore, MediaWiki and the rest name their JSON fields in
# run-together lowercase. These appear as string literals in the mapping layer
# and in test fixtures, and they are not ours to rename.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deliberate misspellings.
#
# The fuzzy-lookup tests exist to prove that "valorent" finds Valorant. Spelling
# them correctly would delete the test.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
leage
leagu
overwatc
valorent

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Words this repository spells deliberately.
#
# British forms, coinages the prose uses more than once, and the names of test
# helpers. If one of these appears exactly once, it is probably not worth a
# dictionary entry.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

byebyes
dapm
irating
newi
oldi
papercut
parameterises

undash
